title: Collaborative graffiti wall
description: One shared pixel wall where every painter sees each other's strokes appear live and each other's cursors move in real time. Durable marks (cells) are server-owned, last-writer-wins per coordinate, and stream over the live-query lane; presence (boardCursors) is a TTL-bounded ephemeral collection that never touches SQLite. Exercises LLP 0013 ephemeral realtime alongside the generated app-data surface, projected into Contract through the generated ephemeral read binding and the authored rated publish line.

backend.stalenessPolicy: committed; regenerate with codegen; freshness tracked by artifacts.json inputsHash

seed.note: Seed art: a red heart, a blue/yellow 'SB' tag, and a green sprig, painted by two seed authors.

headless.toolchain: node>=22 (built-in fetch + WebSocket); cargo to build/run the local server

exact.resolver: demos/_kit/exact-resolver.mjs (SNAPBACK_EXACT_ROOT | .snapback/local.json | ../exact | vendor/exact; probes every listed requiredCapability, not just the baseline)
exact.toolchain: bun (to load Exact package exports from an install or local checkout)

macosNative.note: The same graffiti.contract compiles for the macOS native (AppKit/Hermes) target, but Exact has no runnable macOS NSApplication host yet (only iOS runs native today). The runnable GUI target is the web surface, which works in any macOS browser.

react.note: React/Expo adapter is a v0 capability gap; the headless SnapbackClient is the framework-neutral core a React adapter would bind over.

headless: schema load registers cells table + boardCursors ephemeral collection
generated functions load + inspectable (listCells syncable-live, paintCell); capability manifest reports websocket ephemeral publish
paint is server-authoritative with owned system fields
paint by one painter live-syncs to a peer connection
append-only marks resolve last-writer-wins per coordinate
ephemeral presence requires the board room permission (SNAPBACK_EPHEMERAL_UNAUTHORIZED)
cursor presence publishes, fans out to a peer, and coalesces to latest
cursor presence never advances the durable wall version
cursor subscribe + publish ride the live WebSocket, not a private route
TTL expiry prunes an idle cursor without durable tombstones
over-rate publishes rejected (SNAPBACK_EPHEMERAL_RATE_LIMITED) and observable in diagnostics
durable lane stays first under a cursor flood on one connection
inspect distinguishes ephemeral fan-out pressure from durable delivery
contract: graffiti.contract compiles against generated descriptors (honest compile)
generated ephemeral read binding + rated publish resolve through Exact (presence publish is not a durable mutation)
Exact row-shape analysis catches a bad presence field (shape_unknown_member)
browser: wall renders the full pixel grid
local paint flips a cell and persists
two tabs see each other's pixels via durable live push
two tabs see each other's live mouse cursors via the ephemeral binding + channel publish
idle cursors drop on TTL; closed tabs drop on disconnect

capabilityGaps: exact_macos_appkit_host (the macOS native GUI host is not built yet; web is the runnable target)
external_auth (the browser surface asserts its own boardMember room permission; a real auth provider would mint it server-side)
notClaiming: offline-first / local handler replay (this is an Online-class integration)
Partiful-scale throughput (this is a demo shape, not a benchmark)
freehand vector drawing (Contract has no canvas primitive in v0; the wall is a pixel grid — the pointer channel carries presence only)
a standalone macOS .app (awaits the Exact AppKit host; the wall runs on web, including in macOS browsers)
